{"consolidated_memory":"**billing/invoice_totals.py: Three separate off-by-one cent issues**

All three issues occurred in the same area of billing/invoice_totals.py (totals calculator, billing side) and all manifested as a one cent gap in reconciliation reports. All were reproduced by totaling an invoice with three prorated lines.

**OCCASION 1: March 7, 2026**
- Signal: One cent gap in reconciliation report (appeared only after client had already retried once)
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #2342, branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1
- Outcome: flaky test went from 58 failures per hundred runs to zero

**OCCASION 2: March 13, 2026**
- Signal: One cent gap in reconciliation report (appeared only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys)
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #4278, branch fix/off-by-one-cent-2
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 1.1 s to 439 ms

**OCCASION 3: July 31, 2026**
- Signal: One cent gap in reconciliation report (appeared only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK)
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #4418, branch fix/off-by-one-cent-3
- Outcome: the alert stayed quiet for 24 consecutive days

Each issue had a distinct trigger condition and required a different fix, despite the identical symptom and location in the codebase."}
